These compounds are likely interacting with Histone deacetylase 4 through mechanisms that involve zinc-dependent enzymatic activity or regulatory pathways. The scores from the paths indicate a consistent level of confidence in the association, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated. The evidence is supported by the presence of multiple zinc-based agents with the same target, suggesting a broader biological context in which Zinc may influence histone acetylation. However, the precise role of Zinc in modulating Histone deacetylase 4 activity requires further experimental validation.
